455:t_1:3.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$　Hangar～

455:t_1:4.en:
$$カイエン$$
「...All right. I'll talk to $$アマタ$$.」

455:t_1:6.en:
$$カイエン$$
「That's unusual. You don't often call me that.」

455:t_1:7.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Yeah... But that's how I feel right now.」

455:t_1:8.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「I don't really know why myself...」

455:t_1:9.en:
$$カイエン$$
「But fighting isn't a game. If you say you'll do it, I won't let you hold everyone back.」

455:t_1:10.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「I know. ...I'll do it, no matter what.」

455:t_1:11.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Even if I have to stake my life on it.」

455:t_1:12.en:
$$カイエン$$
「...Don't worry. You'll be protected, no matter what.」

455:t_1:14.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Don't get the wrong idea. I'm not the one who'll protect you.」

455:t_1:16.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Do your best, $$ミコノ$$. You're not the girl who can't do anything anymore.」

455:t_1:18.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$ミコノ$$... Do you have a moment?」

455:t_1:20.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...It'll be all right. I'm sure you can do it.」

455:t_1:21.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「You know what I'm trying to do, don't you, $$セツコ$$?」

455:t_1:23.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I hear that man $$ミカゲ$$ is the $$堕天翅$$ $$頭翅#pilot$$'s hatred given form.」

455:t_1:25.en:
$$セツコ$$
「If anyone can stop him, I'm sure it's you... Do your best.」

455:t_1:26.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「...You've fought $$頭翅#pilot$$ alongside $$神話型アクエリオン$$ before, haven't you?」

455:t_1:28.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「What sort of girl... was $$シルフィ$$?」

455:t_1:30.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「I... want to know about her.」

455:t_2:4.en:
$$アマタ$$
「What the hell is this place...!?」

455:t_2:6.en:
$$アマタ$$
「$$ゼシカ$$, $$アクエリオン$$, and $c... None of them are here...」

455:t_2:10.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Hey... Long time no see, $$アマタ$$.」

455:t_2:15.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「What is the meaning of this!?」

455:t_2:16.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You have no right to do this! Why do you keep interfering with the Wingless!?」

455:t_2:18.en:
$$不動$$
「...It is true that those who become higher-dimensional life-forms may not interfere with humanity more than necessary...」

455:t_2:19.en:
$$不動$$
「But don't you think that rule itself is presumptuous?」

455:t_2:21.en:
$$不動$$
「We may indeed have obtained eternity and the $$オリジン・ロー$$, but that is all.」

455:t_2:22.en:
$$不動$$
「We feel joy, anger, sorrow, pleasure, hatred, and love... Nothing has changed.」

455:t_2:23.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You bastard...! Where did you send that woman!?」

455:t_2:25.en:
$$不動$$
「I sent her to the place where you were born.」

455:t_2:34.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「You're the ones from twelve thousand years ago...!」

455:t_2:35.en:
$$アポロ$$
(Ah... That scent is so familiar...)

455:t_2:36.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「$$アポロ$$...! Is that you, $$アポロ$$!?」

455:t_2:39.en:
$$シリウス$$
(My dear sister of the future...)

455:t_2:41.en:
$$頭翅#pilot$$
(The girl born of an $$天翅$$ and a Wingless, who tormented me and then saved me...)

455:t_2:43.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Twelve thousand years ago... you sacrificed yourselves to save me and the world from dimensional collapse...」

455:t_2:44.en:
$$シリウス$$
(There is no need to apologize.)

455:t_2:46.en:
$$シリウス$$
(You and we simply did everything we could at the time...)

455:t_2:47.en:
$$アポロ$$
(Besides, just like we promised... we've met again like this.)

455:t_2:48.en:
$$頭翅#pilot$$
(Yes... Humans and $$天翅$$s were connected...)

455:t_2:49.en:
$$頭翅#pilot$$
(That is the mingling of waters... Everything blends together and becomes beautifully clear...)

455:t_2:50.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「$$アポロ$$... But I'm... no longer $$シルヴィア$$...」

455:t_2:51.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You hateful woman, who stole the one I loved from me not once, but twice!」

455:t_2:53.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「When the universe collapsed twelve thousand years ago, $$頭翅#pilot$$, an $$天翅$$, offered himself to the $$機械天使アクエリオン$$ alongside the humans...」

455:t_2:54.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「He was supposed to become one with his beloved $$太陽の翼$$, but at the final moment, $$頭翅#pilot$$ learned it had all been a lie.」

455:t_2:55.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Yes...! The $$機械天使アクエリオン$$ was not $$アポロニアス#pilot$$, the $$太陽の翼$$!」

455:t_2:57.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I am the shadow of the heart that $$頭翅#pilot$$, who lived for love, cast away...!」

455:t_2:60.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「Stop tormenting yourself any further.」
